title: Universally Japanese rings and Nagata rings
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring. (1) $R$ is *universally Japanese* if for every ring map $R\to S$ of finite type [def-weil-pbc-finite-type-algebra] with $S$ an integral domain, $S$ is N-2 [def-weil-pbc-japanese-domain]. (2) $R$ is a *Nagata ring* if $R$ is Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] and for every prime ideal $\mathfrak p\subset R$ the domain $R/\mathfrak p$ is N-2.
